CREATE TABLE [d360].[STG_EDS_DID_COLLECTIONINSTITUTION]
(
	[H] [varchar](25) NULL,
	[COLLECTION_INSTITUTION] [varchar](100) NULL,
	[REMOVE_FLG] [char] NULL,
	[FILE_NAME] [varchar](50) NULL,
	[insert_dttm] [datetime] NULL
)
WITH
(
	DISTRIBUTION = ROUND_ROBIN,
	HEAP
)
GO


CREATE TABLE [d360].[STG_EDS_DID_COLLECTIONINSTITUTION_SELECT_SRC]
( 
	[COLLECTION_INSTITUTION] [varchar](100) NULL,
	[REMOVE_FLG] [char] NULL,
	[FILE_NAME] [varchar](100)  NULL,
	[JSRC_FLG] [int]  NOT NULL,
	[JTAR_FLG] [int]  NOT NULL
)
WITH
(
	DISTRIBUTION = REPLICATE,
	HEAP
);
GO


CREATE TABLE [d360].[STG_EDS_DID_COLLECTIONINSTITUTION_GROUP_SRC]
( 
	[COLLECTION_INSTITUTION] [varchar](100) NULL,
	[REMOVE_FLG] [char] NULL,
	[FILE_NAME] [VARCHAR](100)  NULL,
	[JSRC_FLG_CNT] [int]  NULL,
	[JTAR_FLG_CNT] [int]  NULL,
	[FILE_DATE] [date]  NULL
)
WITH
(
	DISTRIBUTION = REPLICATE,
	HEAP
);
GO


CREATE TABLE [EDS].[DID_COLLECTIONINSTITUTION]
( 
	[COLLECTION_INSTITUTION] [varchar](100) NULL,
	[REMOVE_FLG] [char] NULL,
	[SCD_Start_Date] [date]  NULL,
	[SCD_End_Date] [date]  NULL,
	[isActive] [char](1)  NULL,
	[isLatest] [char](1)  NULL,
	[BNK_CODE] [varchar](20)  NULL,
	[SOURCE_CODE] [varchar](20)  NULL,
	[FILE_NAME] [varchar](100)  NULL,
	[insert_dttm] [datetime]  NULL
)
WITH
(
	DISTRIBUTION = HASH([COLLECTION_INSTITUTION]),
	HEAP
);
GO
